description:
Receive outcomes and handlers are filled by the runtime: the native receive matcher (src/compiler2/native_codegen/receive.rs) builds each subject whole, keeps its own outcome_reads and has no cursor form; the interpreter's try_match_backend_receive hands whole words. After the three steps before this one, they are the remaining place where a matched rest is whole by rule.

Change: a receive outcome's and a handler's parameters arrive by their layouts like any other entry's, so a rest the arm only walks is a cursor. What the receive matcher keeps only because it must build whole values is removed.

To establish first: what the matcher can hand over as a source and position (the message is copied into the receiver's heap before the arm runs), and whether its outcome_reads is then the same idea as the dispatch's and one of the two goes.

Done when: no entry origin hands a matched rest whole by rule; gate green; fixtures on three paths.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.cursor-fold.html (approved by the user 2026-11-15: remove special cases; what is no longer needed is fully removed).
title: A rest matched out of a received message or a rescued exception arrives the way its arm reads it
